provenance_note: Captured after live_slc implementation and unit-level testing, before the required one-session dry_run gate. Tier 1 (9 files) matches byte-for-byte the hashes independently captured for the stock_trend_momentum_v2 work and the SLC backtest runner - zero drift across this entire rollout. Tier 2 covers SLC signal-fidelity dependencies and live_slc/scripts own execution-critical files (excluding guardrails.py itself, which cannot hash itself without circularity - see its own module docstring), re-freezable only via a new baseline + a new SlcActivationEvent. Re-frozen after the rev. 11 integration-completion pass (real transactional migrations, split detection + atomic rebuild, delayed read-only reconciliation in preflight, RTH enforcement at the bar_cache boundary, Decimal tick-precision rounding, the corrected 3-outcome broker reconciliation model, and the engine-parity self-check feeding the dry_run session gate) - Tier 1 (9 files) verified byte-for-byte unchanged across this entire pass; Tier 2 reflects the live_slc/ files this pass modified plus two new modules (migrations.py, split_detection.py). Still captured before the required one-session dry_run gate has actually been run - paper_active has never been reached. Re-frozen again after a targeted correctness review surfaced 11 real defects in the order-lifecycle/closeout paths (missing nested=True on bracket-leg fetches, a still-live zero-fill order labeled canceled without ever calling cancel, a canceled-with-partial-fill silently discarded, network failures during submission misclassified as confirmed rejections, partial fills never persisted as local positions before flattening, post-fill risk using stale equity, target verification unable to see legs at all plus no qty check plus the new leg id never saved, exit_via_marketable_replacement dead code with no caller, protective/target order ids never persisted on SlcPosition, closeout blind to orphaned broker positions, closeout fabricating exit price from the theoretical target instead of the real close fill and never marking positions closed, a broker-flat readback that both silently defaulted True and treated any read exception as flat, and a cycle-run status field unconditionally overwritten to "completed" even when "failed" was passed) - all fixed, all now covered by dedicated regression tests, full suite green. Re-frozen a third time after a second review pass surfaced 4 more defects: exit_via_marketable_replacement polled the pre-replace (stale) order id instead of the new one Alpaca issues on a successful replace; orphan broker-position matching could associate an untracked position with ANY historical filled SLC order for that symbol rather than proving a specific one (now requires exactly one unclosed, price-corroborated candidate, with zero/multiple candidates left unresolved and explicitly flagged, never guessed); the broker-flat calculation excluded unresolved orphans and could report True while an unaccounted-for position stayed open; and a failed post-fill equity refresh silently fell back to stale pre-fill data instead of failing closed. All fixed, all covered by dedicated regression tests, full suite green. Re-frozen a fourth time after a third review pass surfaced 3 more defects: dry-run proposals never contributed to committed_notional_this_cycle (only real submissions did), letting multiple simulated proposals in one cycle each be sized against the full account as if the other never happened; an unresolved orphan broker position was only ever logged as an SlcAuditEvent that nothing re-read, so system_wide_entry_block_reasons() never saw it and a later cycle could resume entries while it stayed genuinely unresolved (now a real, persistent blocking condition); and the orphan matcher's price/direction/quantity corroboration was optional and incomplete (now all three are required: fill price vs broker avg_entry_price, long/short side, and exact requested-vs-broker quantity). All fixed, all covered by dedicated regression tests, full suite green. Re-frozen a fifth time for a single, narrowly-scoped SDK-compatibility fix: _discover_orphan_slc_positions() normalized broker_position.side via a bare str(), which on a real alpaca-py PositionSide enum produces "PositionSide.LONG"/"PositionSide.SHORT" rather than "long"/"short", rejecting every genuine Alpaca position as a direction mismatch - concealed by mocks that used plain strings. Fixed to unwrap the enum via .value before lowercasing, with a getattr fallback so plain strings still work unchanged. No trading/signal/entry/exit/sizing/risk rule was touched. Covered by dedicated tests using the actual installed PositionSide enum (LONG/SHORT corroboration, opposite-side rejection, missing/empty side, and continued plain-string compatibility). Only live_slc/run_slc_live.py changed in Tier 2. Re-frozen a sixth time for a fresh-database idempotency fix: migrations.py verified UniqueConstraint satisfaction by a synthesized index name only ("uq_<table>_<cols>"), but SQLite create_all() satisfies an inline UNIQUE constraint via its own automatically-named sqlite_autoindex_<table>_<n> index - so a second init_live_slc_db() call on a brand-new database raised SchemaDriftDetected against a schema that was actually correct. Fixed by detecting unique-index equivalence via PRAGMA index_list/index_info column comparison (any name, exact ordered column + genuine-uniqueness match), applied identically to schema verification and to safe index creation. Wrong-column and non-unique indexes still fail closed as drift; duplicate rows still block creating a missing unique index. No trading/signal/entry/exit/sizing/risk rule was touched; schema version was not bumped since no schema shape changed, only verification logic. Only live_slc/migrations.py changed in Tier 2. Re-frozen a seventh time for a preflight engine-parity data-source fix: _run_engine_parity_self_check() previously sampled the live universe via _cached_bars() (SlcFiveMinBar), which is always empty immediately after a real bootstrap - bootstrap() persists only the serialized ReducerState, never the ~1M historical bars themselves, into SlcFiveMinBar - so the daily parity gate necessarily returned False for as long as it took real trading days to accumulate enough live bars. Fixed by sourcing the check exclusively from the frozen, hash-verified reducer validation corpus (research/slc_4h_5m_stock_v1_reducer_validation_corpus_manifest.json, tests/fixtures/slc_reducer_corpus/*.csv) instead of live data: every required fixture is SHA-256-verified against the manifest before use, reducer.check_engine_parity() (extended with an optional, default-None window_end parameter used only by this corpus path - every existing live caller is unaffected) is run on each, and the check fails closed on a missing/tampered/unparseable fixture, zero compared signals, or a genuine parity mismatch - never a silent fallback to the live cache. Makes zero network/broker calls. Does not re-download or persist the ~1M-bar bootstrap window; the existing live SlcFiveMinBar rolling cache and reducer bootstrap/state behavior are unchanged. No trading/signal/entry/exit/sizing/risk rule was touched; schema/rule freeze is unaffected. live_slc/run_slc_live.py and live_slc/reducer.py changed in Tier 2. Re-frozen an eighth time after the first real scheduled dry-run session exposed orchestration-only defects: dry-run proposals were not counted across process restarts, so the fixed two-new-trades-per-day limit reset every cycle; missing-bar observations were incorrectly accumulated as duplicate/stale signals; signal counters stayed zero; the activation gate did not enforce 95% of the fixed 72-cycle schedule; cycle duration was not persisted; and simultaneous cycle/guardian wrappers contended on one log file. Fixed with DB-backed daily dry-run capacity, separated telemetry, a 69/72 minimum gate, persisted cycle duration, distinct scheduler logs, and a 45-second guardian trigger offset. Deprecated pandas UTC calls were replaced with equivalent supported calls to remove scheduler-log noise. Signal/entry/exit/sizing/risk rules are unchanged; execution remains disabled.
